tasks.name: Inventory bytecode opcodes, stack layout and data

tasks.name: Port interpreter, procedures and interpreter state
tasks.evidence: Core CI verifies a bounded CE typed-stack interpreter, synthetic procedures and an explicit opt-in native host. A read-only CE game-clock host now executes invented local interrupt procedure bytecode with original setupCall/0x8025 return framing, while the underlying VM remains unchanged; full game-connected script execution is not implemented.

tasks.name: Port engine opcodes, callbacks and event dispatch
tasks.evidence: Core CI verifies explicit CE MAP/local/game-global variables, scripted time and calendar/last-visit opcodes, isolated timer add/remove, and read-only source-derived op_game_time_advance 0x80FC queue-poll ordering. The advance planner never mutates a live clock or processes game events; full engine callbacks and native world mutations remain absent. Four read-only CE object property opcodes (tile/elevation/PID/art FID) now run only via caller-owned opaque snapshots; 20 source-derived C++/Rust bytecode comparisons and rejection tests passed core CI 39999029788. No actual game object pointers or engine callbacks. A further Rust core CI regression at 39999702765 verifies mixed object and game-global bytecode under an explicit composite host; the previous clock-only host still rejects object reads.

tasks.name: Golden-script differential tests versus CE
tasks.evidence: Core CI tests independent adapted C++/Rust invented fixtures: 48 CE clock/date/visit cases, 15 local interrupt cases including pure clock native host, CE source-derived time-advance queue-poll ordering, eight combined game-clock/native traces, ten script_q timer cases, and earlier typed VM/data tests. This does not establish compatibility with original compiled Fallout CE or real game golden fixtures. Four read-only CE object property opcodes (tile/elevation/PID/art FID) now run only via caller-owned opaque snapshots; 20 source-derived C++/Rust bytecode comparisons and rejection tests passed core CI 39999029788. No actual game object pointers or engine callbacks.
